You can also listen to the soundtrack on [url=https://dbxy.bandcamp.com/album/cake-bash-the-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6qRNQRmweAnaZ6iJYgNiaO]Spotify[/url], [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcXdjQXThghThgasDIG6tMq_UlB0puP7P]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/cake-bash-original-game-soundtrack/1635061347]Apple Music[/url]!

All music composed and produced by dBXY - Levi Bond, David Robinson, and Ben Rawles.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34134759/af9e6f37aac044dbc9fa9dca8a86d647593bd324.png[/img]

It's our favourite time of the year, so we’ve added a few spooky treats to warm your heart while the weather gets cold!


[h2]Enabled forever, starting today...[/h2]

[h1]CREEPY FLAVOURS[/h1]
We’ve added seven gooey, ghostly cake flavours to try. Clair the eclair has been transmutated into the mummified Clairaoh, and Slice has become Bites the vampire, or Flan Helsing, if you prefer.

[h1]TEA-1000s[/h1]
All the halloween flavoured bots have a dark secret. You might even hear them say, “...I’ll be snack."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34134759/3d54381134eaaaba6e37b94a5b0a87996b543e07.gif[/img]


[h2]Enabled every year from October 15th until November 15th...[/h2]


[h1]DECORATIONS[/h1]
The Get Tasty cafe is full of spiderwebs, ghost stickers, spooky bunting, and a brand new dark and creepy atmosphere. Our tasty rainbow cupcake mascot has a cool new bat - I mean hat, and the start menu is filled with sweet decorations too!

[h1]NEW MUSIC[/h1]

Our new tunes are all:
[X] Minor key
[X] With spooky instruments
[X] Perfect for any Halloween party!



It’s been a whole year since Cake Bash was released, and thanks to your feedback we’ve fixed bugs and added requested features, but now we’ve gone all out to make you smile! There are only two of us working on the game and we’re very grateful to everyone who’s tried it so far, you're the best. 

Have a very happy Halloween,
Laura and Clément

notes.title: Announcing Get Tasty game mode & 2 new minigames
notes.content:
It's not long until Cake Bash releases on Thursday the 15th, so we're really excited to share some delicious new content with you. Get Tasty is the main way to play, and we've made a video showing how all it all works. We've also created two super tasty videos showcasing two of our new minigames: Scones & S'mores and Wasp Attack. Watch all our tasty videos below.

[h2]Get Tasty[/h2]

Follow your cakes on a journey through the cafe as they play a series of matches - win chocolate coins, buy sweet toppings and try your best to be the tastiest! This is the place where you can play online with friends, and where you can unlock all the game modes and flavours for your cakes too!

[previewyoutube=H0HglcMiNHk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Wasp Attack[/h2]

Wasps have invaded the family barbeque! Watch their path and hit them with your spatula. Keep up a combo by not missing, which is absolutely the way to win.

[previewyoutube=bvba8ICIOnU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Scones and S'mores[/h2]

Pipe filling into the bakes to prepare them for a bake sale battle. The more of the base you cover, the more points you’ll win. You’ll need to reload your piping bag at the right time too!

[previewyoutube=b8qPh-qRI6c;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cake Bash at EGX Rezzed
notes.content:
[h2][b]Update: EGX Rezzed has been moved to summer. You can read the full statement by EGX here: https://www.egx.net/rezzed/news/a-message-to-our-visitors-regarding-covid-19[/b][/h2]

The UK’s biggest indie game event is just around the corner and we’re going to be there. From the 26th to the 28th March, you can play Cake Bash at EGX Rezzed at our booth!

As always, there will be lots of competitions for you to enter. Be sure to take lots of photos at out Cake Bash photo op or with our plushies for a chance to win one of our popular tees.

[b]Are you now ready to play our games? You can find us downstairs by the south fountain.[/b]

For the first time, we’re showcasing plenty of new games modes.  One of our new modes is Fork Knife:  Run away from the forks and knives, whoever survives this dangerous encounter, wins the round! One could say it’s a bit of a Gateau Royale!

There is one more goodie to keep an eye on – sign up to our newsletter, and show us your confirmation email at EGX Rezzed and get a free Cake Bash pin.
